readerCopy.body: Past work may open a door you could not have opened from scratch. When the Sun sextiles the North Node, recognition you already earned can support something newer through a recommendation, introduction, invitation, or first chance to lead in unfamiliar territory. The useful part is not being rewarded for staying the same; it is that old credibility can give you a chance to try something different. Accept the opportunity if it gives you experience, access, or proof you can carry into the role you want to grow into.
